question: Peak gas demand is 113,950 Sm3/h (GT 23 kg/s at the maximum case per IF-01 plus the auxiliary boiler and the gas-fired station preheaters), 99 % of the firm booking of 115,000 Sm3/h (DP-OWNR-0033). Please confirm that the Owner will book at least 120,000 Sm3/h firm, or that the auxiliary boiler and the preheaters may be interrupted at GT full load in winter.
response: The Owner will increase the firm booking to 120,000 Sm3/h from the first gas date; the network operator has confirmed the capacity is available at the TP-G1 connection.
subject: Firm gas capacity booking has 1 % margin over the plant peak demand
